"""Independent bounded probes of the frozen session-cleanup candidate."""
from __future__ import annotations
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path("/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8")
REPO = ROOT / "agent-dev-kit"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RTK = Path("/workspace/scratch/fe8de3b42084/verification-tools/rtk")
HELPER = REPO / "tests/test_skill_command_examples.py"
EXPECTED = "a17791efaf2ad0dd7b0923dc49b4c219df0a3eb563495b419cc9de281cb12fc0"
OLD = ROOT / "delivery-11.4.0/adk-ci-timeout-diagnosis/post-attempt2/ninja_cleanup_probe.py"

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def utc():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()

result_path = OUT / "probe-result.json"
if result_path.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Refusing to overwrite an independent observation")
result = {"started_at": utc(), "scope": "IR-S1/S2/S3 as preregistered in probe-plan.json",
          "helper_before_sha256": digest(HELPER), "checks": []}
assert result["helper_before_sha256"] == EXPECTED
frozen_index = json.loads((ROOT / "delivery-11.4.0/adk-ci-runtime-review/raw-source-index.json").read_text())
assert digest(OLD) == frozen_index["sources"]["synthetic_probe_script"]["sha256"]
copy_dir = OUT / "original-counterexample"
copy_dir.mkdir()
copy = copy_dir / OLD.name
shutil.copyfile(OLD, copy)
result["original_probe_sha256"] = digest(OLD)
result["copied_probe_sha256"] = digest(copy)
assert result["original_probe_sha256"] == result["copied_probe_sha256"]
began = time.monotonic()
command = [str(RTK), "proxy", sys.executable, str(copy)]
completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
(copy_dir / "stdout.log").write_text(completed.stdout)
(copy_dir / "stderr.log").write_text(completed.stderr)
raw = json.loads((copy_dir / "ninja-cleanup-probe-result.json").read_text())
message = raw.get("helper_result", {}).get("message", "")
snapshot = json.loads(message.split("process_snapshot: ", 1)[1].split("\nstdout:", 1)[0])
leaf = raw.get("leaf_self_record")
owner = raw.get("owner_observed_externally")
after = raw.get("leaf_after_helper_return")
s1 = {
    "command": command, "original_expected_defect_oracle_exit_code": completed.returncode,
    "original_conclusion": raw.get("conclusion"), "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - began,
    "same_helper_bytes": raw.get("helper_sha256") == EXPECTED,
    "timeout_preserved": raw.get("helper_result", {}).get("kind") == "AssertionError" and "budget=0.2s" in message,
    "different_pgid_same_sid": bool(leaf and owner and leaf["pgid"] != owner["pgid"] and leaf["sid"] == owner["sid"]),
    "leaf_in_snapshot": bool(leaf and leaf["pid"] in {p["pid"] for p in snapshot["processes"]}),
    "leaf_not_live_after_helper": after is None or after["state"] in {"Z", "X"},
    "live_owned_after_independent_cleanup": raw.get("live_owned_processes_after_cleanup"),
    "independent_cleanup": raw.get("independent_cleanup"),
    "raw_helper_message": message,
}
s1["accepted"] = (
    s1["same_helper_bytes"] and s1["timeout_preserved"] and s1["different_pgid_same_sid"]
    and s1["leaf_in_snapshot"] and s1["leaf_not_live_after_helper"]
    and s1["live_owned_after_independent_cleanup"] == []
    and ("cleanup=complete" not in message or not s1["independent_cleanup"])
)
result["checks"].append({"id": "IR-S1", **s1})

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("reviewed_examples", HELPER)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
foreign = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(10)"], start_new_session=True)
try:
    observed = module.process_status(foreign.pid)
    rejected = []
    for kind, fabricated, sid in (
        ("foreign_sid", dict(observed, sid=os.getsid(0)), os.getsid(0)),
        ("different_start_ticks", dict(observed, start_ticks=observed["start_ticks"] + 1), observed["sid"]),
    ):
        returned = module.terminate_owned_process(fabricated, sid, time.monotonic() + 0.5)
        rejected.append({"kind": kind, "return_value": returned, "fixture_still_alive": foreign.poll() is None})
    result["checks"].append({
        "id": "IR-S2", "actual_fixture": observed, "branches": rejected,
        "accepted": all(row["return_value"] is False and row["fixture_still_alive"] for row in rejected),
        "limit": "Actual pidfd opened; no PID reuse was attempted. Only forged SID/starttime records were supplied.",
    })
    capability_results = []
    for namespace, attribute in ((module.os, "pidfd_open"), (module.signal, "pidfd_send_signal")):
        old = getattr(namespace, attribute)
        delattr(namespace, attribute)
        try:
            status = module.cleanup_owned_session(
                observed, {"status": "observed", "processes": [observed]}, time.monotonic() + 0.5)
        finally:
            setattr(namespace, attribute, old)
        capability_results.append({"missing": attribute, "status": status, "fixture_still_alive": foreign.poll() is None})
    result["checks"].append({
        "id": "IR-S3", "branches": capability_results,
        "accepted": all(row["status"] == "session-unverified" and row["fixture_still_alive"] for row in capability_results),
        "limit": "Capabilities were removed only in this diagnostic Python process and restored immediately.",
    })
finally:
    foreign.kill()
    foreign.wait(timeout=2)
    result["unrelated_fixture_reaped"] = foreign.returncode is not None
result["helper_after_sha256"] = digest(HELPER)
result["helper_unchanged"] = result["helper_after_sha256"] == EXPECTED
result["ended_at"] = utc()
result["all_accepted"] = result["helper_unchanged"] and all(row["accepted"] for row in result["checks"])
result["exit_code"] = 0 if result["all_accepted"] else 1
result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(result["exit_code"])
